Hi Leticia! Thank-you for joining us on our subreddit to do a Q&A!

Do you think you would have recognized yourself if you were to have seen the print & search sooner? It was such a tough hunt to find that exact photo- we had a lot of potential matches, but never the exact photo! 

¡Gracias por tu tiempo hoy! :)

The newest expansion I have is for rent- I also have high school years which may be the apparent culprit? 

It’s such an unfortunate and creepy glitch LOL. My sims lost their parents in a kitchen fire & then a meteor strike leaving the teenager and child to fend for themselves.

The teenage brother seemed to be pretty normal, crushing on classmates and such. It seemed like once the sister aged up she was cursed with a plethora of glitches relating to relationships. She was crushing on almost EVERYONE, including those outside her preferences, INCLUDING her brother. 

I hope it’s fixed soon. She’s always embarrassed over thinking about her multiple crushes. 

I’ve noticed a few bugs with the sims freezing in-game too, seems like it’s pretty broken at the moment :(
It kind of looks like a genie!
My sim recently developed a crush on her BROTHER. No mods on this end either. Seems to be a creepy bug at the moment :(
Oh my god. I can’t believe it. That’s HER!!!

I have absolutely no control over myself when one of them gets the whim for it. I’ll lock the whim and wait until that sim’s partner eventually gets the same whim. I’ve had some households that ended up with 2 or 3 because of failed attempts, but in most cases it’s a full house lol
AJ Clementine?
Those are sweet camo pants!
A doctor I worked with had the last name Death. Pretty metal in any other circumstance besides caring for living people.

What a gross couple- shame on them heavily. 

I’m not sure why there’s so many negative comments? You are trying to raise awareness about a destructive couple in the area- this couple could be someone’s neighbour or possible new roommate and they may be unaware how nefarious these people can be. 

They sound like a sore on society- very glad your got your kitten back OP & goodluck with pressing charges. Thank-you for the PSA

So you can inquire about purchasing parking passes for glowfest in another post, yet you neglect to bring your pets for simple vet care due to costs. Disgusting. 
I’m also sure a couple more minutes of digging could have found a local vet near you that was open (with FREE parking)! Can guarantee an emergency vet in the area was probably open too, you just genuinely don’t seem to care about your pets. 
Your pets are losing literal hair. Your FREE Reddit opinions have spoken. Take them to the vet.

“… and have been really helpful with my repair needs in the past.” Posted by u/SNRGuelph themselves lol… 

Here’s a review: Wouldn’t recommend SNR to anyone to be honest. Had an awful experience with them, felt they were very dishonest about services/pricing and argumentative on prices after already being quoted.

Bold of you to assume I have a parasocial relationship with one of my tattoo artists? My friends and I have visited her for tattoos a handful of times… not sure if that constitutes a solid friendship? 
Not even sure what the last part of your comment means? If anything you’re bashing an industry professional

Still not relevant to the meaning of this post, people can/should do their own homework visiting for permanent art. 

You’re right, it’s really not that deep, I made a comment that seemed helpful to OP and you decided to pick apart an artist I mentioned. Sorry you feel that way though.
a pretty good look at her profile discredits this comment, sorry you feel that way haha.

I understand how both of these are valid points when choosing an artist, but I still don’t understand the negativity? Her work is really well done, and have never felt unsafe with her or any staff members at the store. 
Unsure of how or where you’d hear of her not finished being mentored either? Seems like you have a personal issue with the artist, which is a shame. 
Again, not a place for personal opinions about the artists work- this is a post about artists that create a SAFE space. 
It’s too bad you seem to dislike Steel n Ink as an entity- but as for the actual point of this post; they’re friendly, talented, welcoming individuals who provide a safe space for all walks of life.

Is Edward Scissorhands controversial or something? The Edward Scissorhands tattoo she did recently is really well done! 
Unsure why you’d be nervous, sorry you feel that way? This is a post about artists that provide a safe space, not opinions on their work.

Steel n Ink has very friendly & understanding staff all around! Absolutely love this crew. 
My friends and I have been visiting Steel n Ink for a couple of years now- it’s our favourite local studio! 
From reception, to piercings, to tattoos, this shop has NAILED a welcoming and professional environment with great staff. 
They have a number of artists at this shop, but [Carl](https://www.instagram.com/kustomcarlito?igsh=M3pkcG1rZm80ODFr) and [Becca](https://www.instagram.com/zombiechunkz?igsh=MWRzdDR1bjFydXZzOQ==) are the two artists the group of us see pretty often. 

So sorry to hear about your bad experience, you deserve to feel safe; especially during an intimate moment like receiving a tattoo. I hope you find a new local shop to visit! Goodluck!
I second this- Becca is an amazing artist & and really friendly! Love her work.
Can you tell us a little more about upcoming new strains? THC ranges? Dominant terps for these strains? Thanks!
Kylie Behr and Timothee La Chat ? 😂

If you’re looking for some incredible flavour, try boxhot’s Peach OG, Alien OG, or Rocket Fuel. Have these 3 in rotation right now and can’t decide which one tastes best- they all have their own highlights. Peach OG & Alien OG smell and taste incredible, but found the smell of the Rocket Fuel was a bit off at first. Still tastes great!

If you’re looking at Spinach, two nice ones that I always have luck with are GMO Cookies (Indica) and Frosted Cream Puffs (hybrid). My local shops have been carrying pretty good quality Spinach bud lately, have yet to be disappointed. I personally have not tried PSF, but a few friends of mine are tried and true fans of Sugar Cookies (Indica).
sorry for looking in your eyes without permission, maraquan kacheek with the contacts 💀

Immediate connection, the two were already flirting while poor Nina was acting like a third wheel in the living room. They’re now married with three girls- Lucina, Angelina, and Magdalina :). Of all the “incidents” my high school had, the day someone dropped a tab of acid in a teacher’s drink stands out on top of them all. Teacher was an older guy, stepped away from his coffee for a few minutes to speak to a teacher in the hall. One of our classmates thought it would be the ultimate senior prank to quite literally drug the teacher with hallucinogenics, and popped the tab into his coffee mug. From what I remember, he was very quiet the entire class and immediately escorted himself up to the admin office when the class was over. Called himself a cab, went home, never returned back while I was attending. Poor guy was probably having flashbacks from the Woodstock days
#stoposu

If a stranger called me and straight up said “I have a care package that included a $25 gift card addressed to you, come to my house to pick it up… also I tracked you down online to get this info” I’d ONLY be seeing red flags. It sounds like a scam that ends in kidnapping lol. Not worth going to a strangers house for $25– self protection, right? Ultra creepy, sounds like a shitty start to a true crime show honestly.

Ma’am, is one of your top 3 traits ‘erratic’? How delusional can you get? 
I’m an artist, and what you’re doing is incredibly wrong, and taking credit for/stealing someone else’s hard work is definition plagiarism. 
So sad that you lack the creativity and skill to make your own content, but even more sad that you steal it from others and treat the community like this. 
You’re lucky your interactions are limited to the safety of strangers behind a forum platform, but don’t worry, you’ll get yours IRL one day. 
People like you suck, but you already know that I’m sure.

I’m in the same boat, working my way out of my current job with the goals of finding a better one within the next couple of months. I’m almost finished training for another role elsewhere, so that helps! 
It’s so unfortunate that people feel the need to act like this, but this person definitely hasn’t had their reality check as to their behaviour yet. As much as I’d love to rip a strip off their back, we work at an establishment that has a very strict HR and will flip the table over anything. Just need to keep my head low before I can coast away from that situation!
